title: Gravitational wave radiation from periodic orbits in regular black holes
summary: Gravitational wave radiation from periodic orbits in some standard regular black hole spacetimes is studied, primarily using known methods (numerical and analytic). We demonstrate specific differences with the singular Schwarzschild geometry by analysing orbit characteristics, gravitational wave strain profiles, and the corresponding power spectrum density, for different values of the regularising parameter `$g$'. Further, we assess our results vis-a-vis the LISA sensitivity curves and show how our results may be useful while developing templates for detecting regular black holes as viable…
